title: Federal Emissions Performance Warranty — Scope Under the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage
content:
# Federal Emissions Performance Warranty — Scope

**Statement.** Within the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage, the Federal Emissions Performance Warranty covers emission control components and the hybrid drive battery for its term; where its emissions-inspection setting is Yes it also covers a repair needed for the vehicle to pass a state emissions inspection, provided the vehicle has been maintained and operated as the manufacturer specifies. Components covered by the Factory Basic Limited Warranty are paid under that coverage while it is in force.

## Scope in brief

| Item | Covered by the Federal Emissions Performance Warranty |
|---|---|
| emission control components | yes, for its term |
| hybrid drive battery | yes, for its term |
| a repair needed to pass a state emissions inspection | yes where the setting is Yes, provided the vehicle has been maintained and operated as the manufacturer specifies |
| a component also covered by an in-force Factory Basic Limited Warranty | paid under the Factory Basic Limited Warranty while it is in force |

## Hypothetical cases

- A vehicle within both terms has an emission control component fail that the Factory Basic Limited Warranty also covers. The repair is paid under the Factory Basic Limited Warranty.
- The Factory Basic Limited Warranty on that vehicle has expired, and the Federal Emissions Performance Warranty is still within its term. The same component is covered by the Federal Emissions Performance Warranty.
- A hybrid drive battery fails within the Federal Emissions Performance Warranty term. It is covered by that warranty.
